topic: How to edit videos with Claude Code: the workflow this studio actually uses

claims.claim: Remotion publishes official agent skills in the GitHub repo remotion-dev/skills, installed with the `skills` CLI (npx skills add remotion-dev/skills). This studio has 12 of them installed.
claims.notes: Verified locally from skills-lock.json; the update command in .claude/skills/remotion-upgrade uses `npx skills`.

claims.claim: Reference analysis pulls frames with FFmpeg and a word-timed transcript with Whisper (faster-whisper), then maps every cut.
